component.name: Tecnomata IPTV
component.summary: Watch live TV, movies and series from your Xtream IPTV service

description.p: Tecnomata IPTV is a desktop client for Xtream Codes IPTV services on Linux. Live TV, movies and series play inside a single window, using an embedded video engine instead of spawning a separate player process per channel.

ul.li: Live TV, movies and series in one window, with a single content list
Per-item resume: each movie and episode remembers its own position, audio and subtitle track
Favorites and recently played, with progress bars and quick resume
"Go live" button to discard buffered delay on a live channel after pausing
Desktop integration via MPRIS (title and playback state in your panel/bar)
Account credentials stored only in the Linux Secret Service (keyring), never on disk

description.p: You need your own Xtream Codes IPTV subscription (server, username and password) to use this app. It does not include, sell or distribute any channels or content.

screenshot.caption: Home screen with the Springfield theme
The four selectable themes: Springfield, Mcfly, Retro 80s/90s and Dog Eyes
Player with audio/subtitle track selection and live info panel
Favorites with resume progress and quick actions

description.p: First packaged release: live TV/movies/series in one window, per-item resume, favorites, four themes and MPRIS integration.
